`install-sh` originated with the X Consortium. An older Autoconf manual states that it was “from the X Consortium and is not copyrighted.”

Its history in Autoconf is more complicated:

- The initial 1994 commit had no copyright notice.
- An MIT copyright notice was added in July 1996.
- The license was later updated to match X11R6, removing an advertising clause.

Sources: [Autoconf 2.13 manual](http://www.chiark.greenend.org.uk/doc/autoconf2.13/autoconf.html); [Autoconf mailing-list discussion](https://lists.nongnu.org/archive/html/bug-autoconf/2018-09/msg00009.html).
